events.source_name: Morris Hall / Live in the House
events.age_guidance: 15+; under-18s must attend with a responsible adult.

events.name: James Campbell's Comedy 4 Kids
events.description: James Campbell returns with his stand-up comedy show for children.

events.name: 'Seascape with rocks and sand' in Acrylics with Mark Warner
events.description: Acrylic seascape workshop with Mark Warner. Students need to bring materials; a materials list and reference image are provided.

events.description: Bring a portable handcraft for two hours of creating, crafting and conversation.

events.name: The Pikachu Art Adventure – Attingham Park
events.description: Daily 1 October to 1 November 2026, 11:00–15:30. A Pokémon/Pikachu family art adventure celebrating the Pokémon Trading Card Game 30th Celebration: discover 30 Pikachu cards by different illustrators, learn fun facts and design your own Pikachu trading card. Pick up a trail sheet at Visitor Reception. Booking not needed and there is no extra event charge, but normal Attingham admission applies.
events.accessibility: Attingham has designated Blue Badge parking, accessible toilets, a Changing Places facility, induction loops and wheelchairs/Trampers available subject to availability. Some areas include steps, cobbles or uneven terrain; see the National Trust accessibility guide before visiting.
events.parking_transport: Main visitor car park on site. National Trust also lists Bus 97 connections from Shrewsbury/Telford with a walk from the Mytton & Mermaid stop.
events.age_guidance: Pokémon fans old and young; no formal age limit stated.

events.name: Birdcatcher – Quatt Village Hall
events.description: Pentabus production in association with Papatango Theatre Company and Middle Child. A darkly comic coming-of-age drama.
events.accessibility: Integrated audio description. Captions/subtitles can be offered through handheld devices at some performances; contact the venue in advance.

events.name: Art Society Teme Valley: The Glasgow Boys
events.description: Alice Foster presents a public Art Society Teme Valley talk on the Glasgow Boys. Visitors £8 on the door; members free.

events.name: Pride Trail – Shrewsbury Museum & Art Gallery
events.description: Runs 19 September to 3 October 2026. The official museum listing describes this as an All Day Event; no exact daily start/end times are published. Free family-friendly trail created by families from the museum's monthly LGBTQ+ meet-up, exploring rainbows and themes of kindness, friendship, respect, self-expression and diversity. Museum admission is also free.

events.name: Ludlow Concert Band Evening Concert
events.description: Evening concert by Ludlow Concert Band in aid of St John’s Church and Hands Together Ludlow. Free admission with a retiring collection.

events.name: Messy Church – Stretton Parish Centre
events.description: Monthly all-ages family gathering with games, crafts, messy activities, a contemporary Bible story, refreshments and a meal together. Runs on the second Thursday of each month except August, 15:30–17:45. The official source does not state a price or booking requirement, so these are left unspecified.
events.accessibility: Stretton Parish Centre venue information confirms a hearing loop.
